name: 94109 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94109 (San Francisco) has 304 nonprofit organizations. 132 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 115 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94109 (San Francisco) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 94109 (San Francisco) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 48 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.
